ideas.pitch: An autonomous data incident response pipeline featuring an evidence gate, verified automated repairs, real pull requests, and automated write-backs to DataHub.
ideas.title: ConvergenceGate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly maps to the grand prize winning pattern of blackbox-datahub by demonstrating architectural resilience and real-world utility, perfectly matching the System Convergence ethos.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router utilizing kNN over an exemplar index with LLM-judge writeback to continuously optimize routing accuracy and minimize inference cost under production stress.
ideas.title: ResilientRouter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of darwin-router by providing concrete, measurable efficiency gains and architectural depth that judges can verify live.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated pre-deployment risk diagnosis engine for enterprise AI workflows that uses coded agents to enforce strict governance protocols.
ideas.title: BPMN-RiskAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning blueprint of fde-agent-uipath by targeting complex enterprise workflows and human-in-the-loop governance demanded by rigorous engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: A testing environment where two identical AI agents engage in strategic economic games to autonomously discover emergent deception and adversarial vulnerabilities without pre-programmed instructions.
ideas.title: AdversarialCrucible
ideas.why_it_could_win: Captures the technical depth and novelty that secured 1st place in the crucible win by showcasing unpredictable agent dynamics and system safety limits.

ideas.pitch: An efficient reasoning framework enabling LLMs to execute complex multi-step logic checks using reinforcement learning and rainbow decoding paths for low-latency execution.
ideas.title: HyperReason
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the rigorous algorithmic execution seen in the hyperreasoning win, appealing directly to judges looking for deep technical optimization rather than superficial wrappers.
